t: Plan Book E | Understanding the Variables | LACERA
s: Prior to the California Public Employees’ Pension Reform Act (PEPRA) taking effect on January 1, 2013, Additional Retirement Credit (ARC) was credit that could be purchased to increase your service credit total.
